alerts.headline: AMBER Alert
alerts.description: AN AMBER ALERT IS BEING ISSUED BY THE CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL ON BEHALF OF THE TORRANCE POLICE DEPARTMENT. ON OCTOBER 10 2026 NYLAH AUSTIN WAS TAKEN FROM LOS ANGELES CALIFORNIA. NYLAH AUSTIN IS A 9 MONTH OLD BLACK FEMALE 18 INCHES TALL WEIGHING 15 POUNDS WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES. NYLAH AUSTIN CLOTHING DESCRIPTION IS UNKNOWN. THE SUSPECT KENNISHA AUSTIN IS A 29 YEAR OLD BLACK FEMALE STANDING 5 FEET TALL WEIGHING 100 POUNDS WITH BROWN HAIR AND BROWN EYES. KENNISHA AUSTIN CLOTHING DESCRIPTION IS UNKNOWN. THE SUSPECT AND VICTIM ARE BELIEVED TO BE ON FOOT. IF SEEN CALL 9 1 1
